diagnostics.message: google_alloydb_user.users only references google_alloydb_cluster.primary, so it is created in parallel with google_alloydb_instance.primary. AlloyDB users (both ALLOYDB_BUILT_IN and ALLOYDB_IAM_USER) can only be provisioned once the cluster has a running instance — the registry documentation for google_alloydb_user includes `depends_on = [google_alloydb_instance.default]` in every example. Without that ordering the user creation can race the instance and fail with a cluster-not-ready error. Add an explicit dependency on google_alloydb_instance.primary, or (preferably) derive the user's `cluster` from the instance so Terraform infers the ordering.
